features.text: Power Clean Big Loads in Under 30 Minutes

With TurboWash® 360°, you can clean larger loads fast and get more done while enjoying the same great washing performance you expect from LG. Five powerful jets with variable sprays surround clothes from multiple angles so detergent can penetrate deep into fabrics for a complete clean even for big loads in under 30 minutes.
Clean Up to 36 Loads with 1 Easy Fill

No more digging out detergent and fabric softener every time you do laundry with ezDispense® Automatic Dispenser, just fill the reservoirs once and you’re set for up to 20 to 36 wash cycles with the versatility of using detergent and softener or detergent only. It adds just the right amount for each load size at just the right time and will even send an alert to your smartphone when it’s time to refill.

With its sleek aesthetic and streamlined design, you may not expect capacity that goes beyond the boundaries of a traditional washer. The massive 5.8 cu. ft. tub accommodates king-size bedding, comforters, oversized towels or washable rugs with ease, all while helping to save time by reducing the number of loads each week. At 29" wide, it’s only slightly larger than standard 27" models but still fits comfortably in most laundry spaces.

Real tempered glass door provides a sleek, stylish look that also resists shock and scratches. The dark chrome door trim offers a finished look that nicely contrasts the brushed steel finish and enhances the premium feel.
Unlike tubs made from porcelain or plastic, the LG NeveRust® Stainless Steel Tub avoids the chips and nicks that can snag fabrics and ruin clothing.
Smarter Home Starts with the LG ThinQ App

The ThinQ app offers control and convenience for smart LG appliances to help you simplify life and enjoy the comforts of home. Manage and monitor your washer remotely, track and download cycles, connect with Google or Alexa voice assistants, and access smart diagnosis, customer support, and more. ThinQ Care appliances send usage, maintenance, and diagnostic alerts to help you keep them running smoothly. ThinQ UP appliances receive software updates for new features and enhancements.

Wash small loads that just can’t wait while cleaning a larger load in the main washer by adding the ingenious LG SideKick® 29" pedestal washer. Controlled via the main washer’s touch panel, you can choose from warm and cold settings and 6 cycles to care for delicates, hand washables, workout wear and more. Elevate your possibilities and elevate your washer for easier loading and unloading.
